### Key Implementation Details:
- **Design System & Aesthetics**: Disciplined, slim desktop productivity UI with 13px Inter typography, quiet 1px line separators, compact 8px radius, and disciplined whitespace hierarchy without hero cards, marketing gradients, or dashboard clutter.
- **Strict Color Token Compliance**:
  - **Light Mode (`Register Documents (Match) - Light Mode`)**: `#f7f8f7` canvas, crisp `#ffffff` modal surface, `#202923` primary text, `#176b50` primary CTA button ("Review batch"), quiet hairline dividers.
  - **Dark Mode (`Register Documents (Match) - Dark Mode`)**: Exact `#101113` background canvas, `#191b1f` modal surface, `#23252a` inputs and container rows, `#32363d` quiet borders, `#eee` primary text, and mint `#9cd7b9` action button (with dark text for high legibility, avoiding any dark-green backdrops).
- **Match Modal Layout (860 × 760 fixed footprint)**:
  - **Fixed Header**: Clear "Register documents" title with Studio North context, dismiss button, and subtle text-only stepper (`Choose` · **`Match`** · `Review` · `Results`) without oversized badges.
  - **3 Document Match Rows**: Clean rows for `briefing.pdf` (2.4 MiB), `welcome-guide.docx` (1.1 MiB), and `budget.xlsx` (840 KiB), featuring editable document reference inputs (`HR-001`, `HR-002`, `HR-003`) and explicit target task selection (`Update project scope`, `Onboard new leads`, `Review Q4 allocation`).
  - **Shared Drive Warning**: Muted amber notice attached to the external spreadsheet row (`Shared drive location: /Operations/Finance. External source backup advised.`).
  - **Compact Assignment Row**: Streamlined inline pickers for `Assignees` (Sarah Jenkins, Alex Rivera), `Reviewer` (Marcus Vance), and `Wave` (Wave 1 - Initial intake), with quiet capacity limit metrics (`3 items (4.3 MiB) · Project limit: 64 items or 250 MiB, 512 tasks`).
  - **Fixed Footer**: Left-aligned "3 selected" counter, secondary "Cancel" button, and a single primary "Review batch" action.
- **Copy & Jargon Constraints**: Purely user-facing project and document terminology with complete elimination of low-level technical jargon."},{"suggestion":"Design the subsequent Review step modal for both modes"},{"suggestion":"Show validation or error state when a reference code is missing"},{"suggestion":"Explore the empty state when no documents are matched yet"}]}

# Maqbool Essential
Use disciplined, slim product UI like Apple Files and Google Drive. Existing 224px sidebar, 70px header, bundled colorful geometric brand and Maqbool wordmark. Inter 13px body, 12px controls, 22px headings. Light #f7f8f7 canvas white surface #202923 text #e2e8e3 fine dividers. Dark #101113 canvas #191b1f surfaces #23252a inputs #32363d dividers #9cd7b9 action; never dark green. White space is intentional, not oversized. Compact rows, 8px corners, no nested card forests, no giant hero/status cards, no decorative illustrations. One main action and one quiet secondary per surface; less frequent actions in a More menu. Stable 860x760 dialogs: fixed header/tabs/footer, scrolling body. No technical implementation terms. Warnings only at the decision they affect. Do not add fake billing, nav, stats, activity sidebars, avatars or fabricated data policies. Purposeful line icons only, 140ms transitions and reduced-motion support.

outputComponents.text:
I have designed both the Light Mode and Dark Mode desktop screens (1440 × 1000) for the **Register documents (Match step)** modal in Studio North Files, adhering strictly to the **Maqbool Essential** design principles.

### Key Implementation Details:
- **Design System & Aesthetics**: Disciplined, slim desktop productivity UI with 13px Inter typography, quiet 1px line separators, compact 8px radius, and disciplined whitespace hierarchy without hero cards, marketing gradients, or dashboard clutter.
- **Strict Color Token Compliance**:
  - **Light Mode (`Register Documents (Match) - Light Mode`)**: `#f7f8f7` canvas, crisp `#ffffff` modal surface, `#202923` primary text, `#176b50` primary CTA button ("Review batch"), quiet hairline dividers.
  - **Dark Mode (`Register Documents (Match) - Dark Mode`)**: Exact `#101113` background canvas, `#191b1f` modal surface, `#23252a` inputs and container rows, `#32363d` quiet borders, `#eee` primary text, and mint `#9cd7b9` action button (with dark text for high legibility, avoiding any dark-green backdrops).
- **Match Modal Layout (860 × 760 fixed footprint)**:
  - **Fixed Header**: Clear "Register documents" title with Studio North context, dismiss button, and subtle text-only stepper (`Choose` · **`Match`** · `Review` · `Results`) without oversized badges.
  - **3 Document Match Rows**: Clean rows for `briefing.pdf` (2.4 MiB), `welcome-guide.docx` (1.1 MiB), and `budget.xlsx` (840 KiB), featuring editable document reference inputs (`HR-001`, `HR-002`, `HR-003`) and explicit target task selection (`Update project scope`, `Onboard new leads`, `Review Q4 allocation`).
  - **Shared Drive Warning**: Muted amber notice attached to the external spreadsheet row (`Shared drive location: /Operations/Finance. External source backup advised.`).
  - **Compact Assignment Row**: Streamlined inline pickers for `Assignees` (Sarah Jenkins, Alex Rivera), `Reviewer` (Marcus Vance), and `Wave` (Wave 1 - Initial intake), with quiet capacity limit metrics (`3 items (4.3 MiB) · Project limit: 64 items or 250 MiB, 512 tasks`).
  - **Fixed Footer**: Left-aligned "3 selected" counter, secondary "Cancel" button, and a single primary "Review batch" action.
- **Copy & Jargon Constraints**: Purely user-facing project and document terminology with complete elimination of low-level technical jargon.
